# SegmentedControl

Pick one of 2–4 mutually exclusive modes for the same content, such as Play/Plan, Wheel/Flow/Both or Day/Week/Month.

`SongNodes.SegmentedControl` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SegmentedControl options={…} value={…} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SegmentedControl" options="{{…}}" value="{{…}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (SegmentedControlProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name when there is no visible label ("Mode"). |
| `labelledBy` | `string` | Id of a visible label element; preferred over label. |
| `options` * | `{ value: V; label: string; icon?: string; ariaLabel?: string; disabledReason?: string }[]` | 2–4 options in a fixed order. |
| `value` * | `V` | Selected value. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: V) => void` | Called on selection; applies immediately. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | Small 26px segments for headers and toolbars. |
| `caps` | `boolean` | Uppercase labels via CSS (Play/Plan). |
| `block` | `boolean` | Stretch to the container width with equal segments. |
